propositions: Closing a ticket triggers _compact_on_close which holds the store write lock for unbounded duration (measured 13m53s), blocking all concurrent agent writes until the git add/commit completes.

The compact-on-close tail acquires nested store locks and git index locks with stacked timeouts that only bound acquisition time, never hold time, allowing compaction to monopolize the write lock while other agents exhaust their acquire budgets.
Compaction is optional housekeeping, not a correctness requirement; removing the close trigger leaves unfolded event logs that are valid and equivalent in meaning to compacted state.
The rebar compact command remains available for manual or out-of-band invocation independent of close, preserving full compaction capability without the lock contention.
Removing _compact_on_close from the close path restores lock-hold duration to seconds (matching other acquisitions: sidecar append, txn.transition_core, signature append) instead of minutes.
